{{Quote|You're a doctor, not a physicist!|Doctor S'hrah, to Jos Vondar|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
'''S'hrah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] active during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Known to have no tolerance for any discipline outside medicine, he taught many pupils. One of S'hrah's students was the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Jos Vondar]]. When Vondar was later working as a surgeon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="MedStar I" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> he thought of his teacher.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
S'hrah was first mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''. Published in [[2004]], ''Battle Surgeons'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
